name: bdo-dir
note: The bdo element (corpus/unicode-bidi, unicode-bidi feature): UA unicode-bidi: isolate-override (Chrome's computed value for Blink html.css's `bdo { unicode-bidi: isolate-override }`, matching the WHATWG bidi-rendering block) plus the dir attribute feeding direction. bdo dir=rtl and dir=ltr inside an LTR paragraph keep their logical box position while their content direction is overridden (the mirrored glyphs fall under the text tier); a block-level bdo dir=rtl resolves text-align:start to the right edge, with its line box at the inline-start edge. Mixed-direction run reordering (an LTR bdo inside an RTL paragraph) is a declared no-UBA divergence, so the corpus exercises each bdo in a matching-direction context.
